subject.title: feat(slack): allow configurable App Home views

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose `channels.slack.appHome.view`, including account-level override and fallback-to-built-in behavior after Slack rejects a custom view?
rationale: This is a new documented operator configuration surface rather than a repair to an established contract, so implementation correctness cannot decide whether the product should own it.

options.title: Sponsor the inline-only contract
options.body: Accept the narrow root/account configuration and require redacted live Slack proof before merge.

options.title: Keep App Home built-in only
options.body: Decline the new configuration surface and close the feature direction without merging the branch.

options.title: Request a different owner boundary
options.body: Ask for a Slack-plugin or external extension design if the configuration should not be part of the bundled channel contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the inline-only contract
recommendation.body: Accept the narrow root/account configuration and require redacted live Slack proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only evidence-backed person connected to the proposed Slack App Home contract, although maintainer sponsorship is still required.
